ar: الملك
en: Sura 67: Al-Mulk
ja: 第67章 王権章

p.src: 67:1  Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion, and He is Most Capable of all things.

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion, and He is Most Capable of all things.
ja: その御手にこそ（全創造の）王権があるお方（アッラー*）は、祝福にあふれておられる。そしてかれは、全てのことがお出来になられるお方。
u.src: 67:1  Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion, and He is Most Capable of all things.

p.src: 67:2  Who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deeds, and He is the All-Mighty, the Most Forgiving.

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
en: Who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deeds, and He is the All-Mighty, the Most Forgiving.
ja: （人々よ、かれは）あなた方のいずれがより善い行いかを試されるべく[1]、死と生をお創りになったお方。かれは偉力ならびない*お方、赦し深いお方であられる。
u.src: 67:2  Who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deeds, and He is the All-Mighty, the Most Forgiving.

ja: [1]　「より善い行い」とは、より（アッラー*に）純化され（婦人章1４６の訳注も参照）、より（スンナ*に則った）正しい行い*のこと。アッラー*は人間をこの世界に置かれ、彼らがいずれそこから立ち去る身であることをお知らせになった上で、彼らに命令や禁止をされ、それに逆行する私欲によって彼らを試練にかけられた。それでアッラー*のご命令に従い、善き行いに努めた者は、現世と来世における褒美を授かる。しかしそうでなかった場合、その報いは悪いものとなる（アッ＝サアディー８７５頁参照）。イムラーン家章1７９、蜘蛛章2及びムハンマド*章３1とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 67:3  Who created seven heavens one above another; you will not see any imperfection[1] in the creation of the Most Compassionate. Look again; can you see any flaw?

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
en: Who created seven heavens one above another; you will not see any imperfection[1] in the creation of the Most Compassionate. Look again; can you see any flaw?
ja: （かれは）組み合わさった[1]七層の天を、お創りになったお方。（それを見る者よ、）あなたは慈悲あまねき*お方（アッラー*）の創造に、いかなる不調和も見出さない。では、視線を（天へと）戻してみるがよい。一体あなたは（そこに）、少しでも亀裂を見出すのか？
u.src: 67:3  Who created seven heavens one above another; you will not see any imperfection[1] in the creation of the Most Compassionate. Look again; can you see any flaw?

en: [1] All parts of the universe are well connected and in perfect harmony and coordination. There is no indiscipline, disorder and discordance in the universe, and nothing is disjointed and out of proportion in the creation of Allah. As for birth defects, genetic mutations and other things that we see in the world are part of this great creation, for perfection cannot be noticed except if the opposite is seen, also as a test for humans.
ja: [1]　一説には、「（階層的に）重なり合った」という意味（アル＝クルトゥビー1８：2０８参照）。

p.src: 67:4  Then look again and again; your sight will turn back to you humbled and weary.

ar: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
en: Then look again and again; your sight will turn back to you humbled and weary.
ja: それから何度も、視線を戻してみるがよい。（そうすれば、）視線は惨めにも疲れ切って、自らのもとに返って来よう。
u.src: 67:4  Then look again and again; your sight will turn back to you humbled and weary.

p.src: 67:5  We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and have made them as missiles to stone the devils[2], and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

ar: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and have made them as missiles to stone the devils[2], and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blazing Fire.
ja: われら*は確かに最下層の天を（星）灯りで飾りつけ、それをシャイターン*らへの射撃とした[1]。そしてわれら*は彼らに、烈火の懲罰を用意したのだ。
u.src: 67:5  We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and have made them as missiles to stone the devils[2], and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

en: [2] Preventing them thereby from eavesdropping in the heavens. See 72:8-10.
ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュル章1７－1８とその訳注、詩人たち章212、22３、整列者章６－1０、ジン*章８－９も参照。

p.src: 67:6  For those who disbelieve in their Lord there will be the punishment of Hell. What a terrible destination!

ar: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: For those who disbelieve in their Lord there will be the punishment of Hell. What a terrible destination!
ja: 自分たちの主*に対して不信仰だった者*たちには、地獄の懲罰がある。その行き先は、何と醜悪なことであろうか。
u.src: 67:6  For those who disbelieve in their Lord there will be the punishment of Hell. What a terrible destination!

p.src: 67:7  When they are thrown in it, they will hear its roaring as it boils up,

ar: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
en: When they are thrown in it, they will hear its roaring as it boils up,
ja: 彼ら（不信仰者*）はその中に放り込まれた時、いきり立った（業火の）その咆哮を聞く。
u.src: 67:7  When they are thrown in it, they will hear its roaring as it boils up,

p.src: 67:8  almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, “Did there not come to you a warner?”

ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
en: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, “Did there not come to you a warner?”
ja: それは（不信仰者*への憤りゆえ）、張り裂けんばかり。そこに集団が放り込まれるたび、その門番たちは彼らに尋ねる。「あなた方には（現世で、あなた方が今味わっている懲罰を警告する）、警告者が到来しなかったのか？」
u.src: 67:8  almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, “Did there not come to you a warner?”

p.src: 67:9  They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has not sent down anything; you are greatly misguided.’”

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
en: They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has not sent down anything; you are greatly misguided.’”
ja: 彼らは（、応えて）言う。「ええ、確かに警告者は、私たちのところに来ました。けれども私たちは（彼を）噓つき呼ばわりし、（こう）言ったのです。『アッラー*は（あなた方に啓示を）何一つ、下されてなどいない。あなた方（使徒*たち）は、大きな迷いの中にあるに過ぎないのだ』」。
u.src: 67:9  They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has not sent down anything; you are greatly misguided.’”

p.src: 67:10  And they will say, “If only we had listened or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of the Blazing Fire.”

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: And they will say, “If only we had listened or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of the Blazing Fire.”
ja: また、彼らは言う。「もし私たちが（真理を求めて）聴き、弁えていたら、烈火の徒とはなっていなかったのに」。
u.src: 67:10  And they will say, “If only we had listened or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of the Blazing Fire.”

p.src: 67:11  Thus they will confess their sins. So away[3] with the dwellers of the Blazing Fire!

ar: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: Thus they will confess their sins. So away[3] with the dwellers of the Blazing Fire!
ja: こうして彼らは自分たちの罪を、認める。ゆえに烈火の徒が、（アッラー*のご慈悲から）遠ざけられるよう。
u.src: 67:11  Thus they will confess their sins. So away[3] with the dwellers of the Blazing Fire!

en: [3] Away from all good and from the mercy of Allah.

p.src: 67:12  Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.
ja: 本当に自分たちの主*を、まだ見ぬままに恐れる[1]者たち、彼らには（罪の）赦しと、（天国での）大いなる報いがある。
u.src: 67:12  Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.

ja: [1]　「（アッラー*を）まだ見ぬままに恐れ」ることについては、預言者*たち章４９の訳注を参照。

p.src: 67:13  Whether you speak secretly or openly, He is All-Knowing of that which is in the hearts.

ar: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: Whether you speak secretly or openly, He is All-Knowing of that which is in the hearts.
ja: （人々よ、）あなた方の言葉を、秘密にしてみよ。あるいは、それを公にしてみよ（、いずれにしても、アッラー*には同じこと）。本当にかれは、胸中にあるものをご存知のお方なのだから。
u.src: 67:13  Whether you speak secretly or openly, He is All-Knowing of that which is in the hearts.

p.src: 67:14  Does He not know His Own creation[4], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?

ar: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
en: Does He not know His Own creation[4], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?
ja: 創造されたお方が、（彼らのことを）ご存知にならないとでも？かれは霊妙な*お方、通暁されるお方だというのに。
u.src: 67:14  Does He not know His Own creation[4], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?

en: [4] Or does He not know those whom He created?

p.src: 67:15  It is He Who made the earth smooth[5] for you, so travel through its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection.

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
en: It is He Who made the earth smooth[5] for you, so travel through its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection.
ja: かれはあなた方のため、大地を平坦にされたお方。ゆえにその方々を歩き、かれの糧から食べるがよい。そしてかれにこそ、（清算と報いのための）復活があるのだ。
u.src: 67:15  It is He Who made the earth smooth[5] for you, so travel through its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection.

en: [5] i.e., subservient and stable.

p.src: 67:16  Do you feel secure that He Who is above heaven will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then suddenly convulse[6]?

ar: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
en: Do you feel secure that He Who is above heaven will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then suddenly convulse[6]?
ja: （不信仰者*たちよ、）一体あなた方は天におられるお方（アッラー*）が、地面をあなた方もろとも沈め給うことから、安全なのか？そしてどうであろう、それ（大地）は（あなた方を滅ぼすまで、）揺れ動くのである。
u.src: 67:16  Do you feel secure that He Who is above heaven will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then suddenly convulse[6]?

en: [6] In a circular motion.

p.src: 67:17  Do you feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not send against you a storm of stones? Only then would you know how [serious] My warning was!

ar: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
en: Do you feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not send against you a storm of stones? Only then would you know how [serious] My warning was!
ja: いや、一体あなた方は、天におられるお方（アッラー*）が自分たちに、石を運ぶ風をお送りになることから安全だというのか？ならば彼らは、わが警告がいかなるものかを知ることになろう。
u.src: 67:17  Do you feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not send against you a storm of stones? Only then would you know how [serious] My warning was!

p.src: 67:18  Those who came before them rejected [the messengers]; then how severe was My response!

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
en: Those who came before them rejected [the messengers]; then how severe was My response!
ja: 彼ら（マッカ*の不信仰者たち）以前の者たちは、確かに（彼らの使徒*たちを）噓つき呼ばわりしたのだ。それで、わが否認はいかなるものだったか？[1]
u.src: 67:18  Those who came before them rejected [the messengers]; then how severe was My response!

ja: [1]　「わが否認はいかなるものだったか？」については、巡礼*章４４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 67:19  Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out and folding in their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. He is indeed All-Seeing of everything.

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
en: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out and folding in their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. He is indeed All-Seeing of everything.
ja: （その無頓着さゆえ、）彼ら（不信仰者*たち）は、自分たちの頭上を羽を広げたり、畳んだり（して飛行）する鳥を見なかったのか？それらを（墜落から）支えられるのは、慈悲あまねき*お方（アッラー*）しかおられない。本当にかれは、全てのことをご覧になるお方。
u.src: 67:19  Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out and folding in their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. He is indeed All-Seeing of everything.

p.src: 67:20  Which is your army that can come to your aid against the Most Compassionate? The disbelievers are in utter delusion.

ar: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
en: Which is your army that can come to your aid against the Most Compassionate? The disbelievers are in utter delusion.
ja: いや（、不信仰者*たちよ）、慈悲あまねき*お方を差しおいてあなた方を援助する、あなた方の軍勢であるこの者[1]とは、誰なのか？不信仰者*たちは外ならぬ、（シャイターン*の）欺きの中にある。
u.src: 67:20  Which is your army that can come to your aid against the Most Compassionate? The disbelievers are in utter delusion.

ja: [1]　アッラー*以外のいかなるものが、いかなる敵に対してどれだけ集結したとしても、それら自体が人を益することは少しもない（アッ＝サアディー８７７頁参照）。

p.src: 67:21  Who is there to give you provision if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion.

ar: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
en: Who is there to give you provision if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion.
ja: いや、あなた方に糧を授けてくれる、この者とは誰なのかーーかれ（アッラー*）が、その糧を（あなた方から）お控えになったとしたらーー？いや、彼らは反抗と（真理への）忌避と共に、歯向かったのである。
u.src: 67:21  Who is there to give you provision if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion.

p.src: 67:22  Who is better guided: the one who walks stumbling and falling on his face or the one who walks upright on a straight path?

ar: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: Who is better guided: the one who walks stumbling and falling on his face or the one who walks upright on a straight path?
ja: 一体、顔を下にして歩く者が、より導かれているのか？それとも、まっすぐな道を正しく歩く者か？[1]
u.src: 67:22  Who is better guided: the one who walks stumbling and falling on his face or the one who walks upright on a straight path?

ja: [1]　前者は、真理が虚妄（きょもう）、虚妄が真理になってしまうという心が逆転した状態にあり、迷いと不信仰に浸（ひた）りきっている者のたとえ。後者は真理を知り、それを尊（たっと）び、それに則って行い、あらゆる言動や状態においてまっすぐな道を歩く者（前掲書、同頁参照）。尚、来世において信仰者は天国へとまっすぐに導かれるが、不信仰者*は、顔から逆さにされて地獄に集められる（イブン・カスィール８：1６1参照）。夜の旅章９７とその訳注、蟻章９０も参照。

p.src: 67:23  Say, “It is He Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and hearts; little do you give thanks.”

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
en: Say, “It is He Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and hearts; little do you give thanks.”
ja: （使徒*よ、）言ってやれ。「かれ（アッラー*）はあなた方を創造(そうぞう)し、あなた方に聴覚と視覚と心を備え付けて下さったお方。（不信仰者*たちよ、）あなた方が感謝することの少ないこと」。
u.src: 67:23  Say, “It is He Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and hearts; little do you give thanks.”

p.src: 67:24  Say, “It is He Who has dispersed you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.”

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
en: Say, “It is He Who has dispersed you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.”
ja: 言ってやるがいい。「かれは、あなた方に大地に繁茂させられたお方。そしてかれの御許にこそ、あなた方は召集されるのだ」。
u.src: 67:24  Say, “It is He Who has dispersed you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.”

p.src: 67:25  They say: “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
en: They say: “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
ja: 彼ら（不信仰者*たち）は、言う。「その約束（復活の日*）は、いつなのか？もし、あなた方が本当のことを言っているのならば」。
u.src: 67:25  They say: “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

p.src: 67:26  Say, “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only a clear warner.”

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: Say, “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only a clear warner.”
ja: （使徒*よ、）言ってやれ。「（復活の日*の到来についての）その知識は、アッラー*の御許にこそある。そして私は、明白なる警告者でしかないのだ」。
u.src: 67:26  Say, “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only a clear warner.”

p.src: 67:27  Then when they see it[7] approaching closer, the faces of the disbelievers will be distressed, and it will be said, “This is what you were asking for[8].”

ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
en: Then when they see it[7] approaching closer, the faces of the disbelievers will be distressed, and it will be said, “This is what you were asking for[8].”
ja: それ（アッラー*の懲罰）が近くに迫るのを目にすると、不信仰だった者*たちの顔つきは（憂鬱さゆえに、）悪くなる。そして彼らには、（こう）言われるのだ。「これが、あなた方が（現世で、その到来を）求めていた[1]ものである」。
u.src: 67:27  Then when they see it[7] approaching closer, the faces of the disbelievers will be distressed, and it will be said, “This is what you were asking for[8].”

en:
[7] The punishment on the Day of Judgment of which they were warned.
 [8] As they were challenging their prophets, saying, "Bring upon us the punishment, if you are truthful."
ja: [1]　「（それは到来しない、と）思い込んでいた」という解釈もある（アッ＝シャウカーニー５：３５2参照）。

p.src: 67:28  Say, “What do you think[9], if Allah causes me and those who are with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: Say, “What do you think[9], if Allah causes me and those who are with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
ja: （使徒*よ、彼ら不信仰者*たちに）言ってやるがいい。「言ってみよ、もしアッラー*が私と、私と共にある（信仰）者を滅ぼされたり、または私たちにご慈悲をおかけになっ（て、罰から救ってくれ）たりしたとしても、一体誰が、不信仰者たちを痛ましい懲罰から守ってくれるのか？
u.src: 67:28  Say, “What do you think[9], if Allah causes me and those who are with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

en: [9] i.e., Inform me.

p.src: 67:29  Say, “He is the Most Compassionate; we believe in Him and put our trust in Him. You will come to know who is clearly misguided.”

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate; we believe in Him and put our trust in Him. You will come to know who is clearly misguided.”
ja: 言ってやれ。「かれは、慈悲あまねき*お方。私たちはかれを信じ、かれに全てを委ねた*。ならば、あなた方は誰がまさに明らかな迷いの中にあったのか、知ることになろう」。
u.src: 67:29  Say, “He is the Most Compassionate; we believe in Him and put our trust in Him. You will come to know who is clearly misguided.”

p.src: 67:30  Say, “What do you think, if your water were to sink deep into the earth, who can bring you flowing water?”

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
en: Say, “What do you think, if your water were to sink deep into the earth, who can bring you flowing water?”
ja: （使徒*よ、シルクの徒*に）言うのだ。「言ってみよ、もしあなた方の水が（地下に沈んで）無くなってしまったら、一体誰が、あなた方に湧き水を与えてくれるというのか？」
u.src: 67:30  Say, “What do you think, if your water were to sink deep into the earth, who can bring you flowing water?”
